loopFlow.label: Loop flow
loopFlow.createIssue.line1: `create-issue` opens the issue with `scripts/issue.sh`: a type and a title.
loopFlow.createIssue.line3: The issue body is the frozen scope of the change.
loopFlow.createIssue.line4: An open BLOCKING question stops the loop on that issue, at any stage.
loopFlow.planIssue.line1: Runs if the issue changes behavior, a page, a component or the structure.
loopFlow.planIssue.line2: A typo or a docs or config tweak goes straight to implementation.
loopFlow.planIssue.line3: Writes the plan file by file, with how it is verified.
loopFlow.implementIssue.line1: Implements the plan, or the issue directly if no plan was needed.
loopFlow.implementIssue.line2: Runs the gate once at the end: the site build, up to three attempts.
loopFlow.loopPath.line1: Looks at the changed files and prints `short` or `full`.
loopFlow.loopPath.line2: `short`: all are `.md` and none is loop configuration.
loopFlow.loopPath.line3: The script decides, not the session's judgment.
loopFlow.reviewChanges.line1: One pass over the diff against `origin/main` and the uncommitted work.
loopFlow.reviewChanges.line2: Every finding needs a failure scenario or a rule it breaks.
loopFlow.reviewChanges.branchClean: no BLOCKING or IMPORTANT findings: goes to `ship`
loopFlow.reviewChanges.branchFindings: BLOCKING or IMPORTANT findings: continues with `verify-findings`
loopFlow.verifyFindings.line1: Rereads the real code and separates problems from false positives.
loopFlow.verifyFindings.line2: Leaves the list of what to fix for `implement-issue`.
loopFlow.fix.line1: Fixes only what was confirmed, in a single cycle.
loopFlow.fix.line2: Minor findings stay noted in the PR for the review.
loopTerminal.title: cloud session
loopTerminal.implementIssue: writes the code and runs the build
loopTerminal.loopPath: there is code: goes to review
